name: zokrates
title: ZoKrates · zkworld
description: The ZoKrates framework as a running submod of zkworld: its toolchain, starters and every ZoKrates project here. A high-level, Python-like language for zkSNARKs on Ethereum. zokrates compiles to R1CS + an ABI, computes witnesses and exports a Solidity verifier. Tests are the shared JSON cases.
